title: BrindleMon
description: Embark on your next Pokémon adventure with BrindleMon! Explore a feature-packed Cobblemon survival world with custom content, an active economy, player trading, events, and endless opportunities to become the ultimate trainer.
body:
# Welcome to BrindleMon!
BrindleMon is a community-focused **Cobblemon Survival** server built for players who love exploring, collecting Pokémon, building, and playing alongside others in a long-term world. Whether you're completing your Pokédex, hunting shinies, creating the ultimate team, or simply building your dream base, there's always another adventure waiting.

## Features
* 🏞️ Survival-focused Cobblemon experience
* 🗺️ Beautiful custom world generation and biomes
* 🏛️ 20+ enhanced structures and dungeons to discover
* ⚔️ RPG-inspired progression through skills and jobs
* 💰 Player-driven economy with Auction House and GTS
* 🎁 Daily, weekly, and monthly rewards
* ✨ Wonder Trade and additional quality-of-life features
* 🗺️ Live online world map
* 🎉 Community events, tournaments, and seasonal activities
* ❤️ Friendly, welcoming community with active staff

BrindleMon is designed around long-term progression instead of rushing to the endgame. Build your home, explore every biome, complete collections, earn money through jobs, trade with other trainers, and create your own journey at your own pace.

## Server Information
**IP:** cobblemon.brindlewood.net
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 (Fabric)
**Platform:** Java Edition

## Useful Links
🌐 Website: https://brindlemon.tebex.io/
🗺️ Live Map: https://monmap.brindlewood.net
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/pX99KKjKQa

Whether you're a longtime Pokémon fan or brand new to Cobblemon, BrindleMon offers a polished multiplayer experience built around exploration, progression, and community. We can't wait to see you in-game!
